versions.changelog: 0.2.0: refined triggering description (hand-reviewed, not benchmarked — the automated trigger-scoring harness could not detect skill triggering via 'claude -p' in this environment). Sharpens the trigger to a self-running loop with a judged outcome + real stop condition, and explicitly excludes near-misses: literal loop code, plain vercel.json/GitHub-Actions cron, and the Vercel Workflow product. Skill body unchanged.

Initial release: methodology skill for designing safe, well-defined agentic loops in Claude Code (six parts, writer/checker split, autonomy ladder, hard-stop gate, command allowlist, proof-run-before-schedule).
